fields.description: Program Description Except for meeting the credit requirements and successfully defended their dissertations, international students shall be conferred appropriate degrees by attaining HSK academic standards stipulated in these Regulations. Undergraduate majors have to pass old HSK level-3 or new HSK level-4 (no less than a score of 195).

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form (This form is uniformly printed by the Health and Quarantine Bureau of China) Color scan copy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form.It must be filled in English,and the medical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete forms or forms without the signature of the attending physician,the official stamp of the hospital,or a sealed photograph of the applicant are considered invalid. Please determine the appropriate time to have medical examination as the medical results is valid for 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Non-criminal Record Report Non-criminal Record Report must be issued by the applicant's local public security authority,usually within 6 months before the submission date of application. * 3. Certificate of HSK * 4. Two Recommendation Letters(written in Chinese or English) 5. Other attachments Such as award certificate,pre-acceptance notice from scholarshipin stitution,a CD of personal musical works(music program applicants),a CD of personal works(fine arts program applicants)including two sketches,two color paintings,and two other works,etc) * 6. The highest diploma must be notarized Relevant documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. Prospective diploma recipients must submit official document issued by your current school to prove your current student status or expected graduation date. * 7. Academic transcripts of high school Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. * 8. 2-inch electronic photo * 9. Photocopy of passport within the period of validity * 10. Study Plan or Research Proposal Study Plan or Research Proposal written in Chinese or English with a minimum of 500words. * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements High school diploma holder. HSK4 certificate.
